> Premier, fully furnished, secure female accommodation & 2BHK/3BHK apartments located directly opposite Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport (LGBI), SOS Road, Azara, Guwahati, Assam 781015.

## Key Features & Amenities
- **24/7 Gated Entry & Exit Access**: Zero curfew restrictions, perfectly accommodating airline rosters, flight attendants, pilots, and night-shift corporate professionals.
- **Self-Cooking Modular Kitchen**: Equipped 24/7 with gas stoves, microwave, refrigerator, and RO water filtration.
- **Fitness Gym**: In-house resident-only fitness and wellness area.
- **Top-Tier Security**: 24/7 CCTV surveillance across all common corridors, gated security guards, and biometrics.
- **Room Types**:
  - Private Single AC/Non-AC PG Rooms (with attached washroom, wardrobe, bed, study desk).
  - Shared Double / Twin PG Rooms.
  - Full Independent 2BHK & 3BHK Furnished Apartments for female professionals, families, and flight crews.
- **High-Speed Wi-Fi & Power Backup**: Uninterrupted inverter/generator power backup and fiber internet.
